Add Forwarding Rule dialog: direction where the host listens and brings connections back to this computer (reverse forward)

en-US.desktop.remote.ports.title: Ports
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.help: A forwarded port listens only on this computer's loopback address (127.0.0.1). Every program on this computer can connect to it, not just Lithe. The host cannot reach this computer through it.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.localChanged: Port {requested} is in use on this computer, so {port} is used instead.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.addInvalid: Enter a port from 1 to 65535, host:port, or a URL such as http://localhost:3000.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.addCredentials: The address can't include a user name or password.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.empty: No ports are listening on the host. Type a port above to forward it anyway.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.disconnected: Not connected. Forwards end with the connection; the local forwards you left running start again when you reconnect.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.readFailed: Could not read the host's listening ports: {reason}
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.limit: Forwarding limit reached for this connection ({maximum}). Stop an active forward first.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.invalidTarget: The host or port is not valid.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.confirmBody: {target} is not the loopback address of {name}. Forwarding it lets every program on this computer reach that address through the host. Continue only if you trust it.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.localBody: Forward {remote} on {name} to this port of this computer's loopback address. If another program uses it, a free port is used instead and the row says so.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.localInvalid: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleReverseOff: Forwarding a host port back to this computer (reverse forwarding) is off by default. You can allow it in Settings › Tools › Remote Workspace.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleHostNote: {name} listens on the port below and connects to the target itself; the data does not pass through this computer. By default it listens only on the host's loopback address (127.0.0.1), so only programs on the host can connect.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleReverseNote: {name} listens on the port below on its loopback address (127.0.0.1) and brings every connection back to a port on this computer's loopback address. Every user of the host can connect to that port.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleListenPlacehold: Leave empty to let the host choose
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleTargetPlacehold: Port, host:port or URL, as the host reaches it
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleLocalPlaceholde: Port on this computer's loopback address, such as 3000
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleAllInterfaces: Listen on every interface of the host
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleAllInterfacesNo: Any computer that can reach the host can connect to this port and reach the target through it. You are asked every time; the choice is never remembered.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleConfirmAll: {name} will listen on {listen} on every interface and forward connections to {target}. Any computer that can reach the host can connect, not just you. Continue only if you trust the host's network.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleConfirmTarget: {target} is not the loopback address of {name}. With this rule, every program that can connect to the host port reaches that address through the host. Continue only if you trust it.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleConfirmReverseT: Forward a Host Port to This Computer?
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleConfirmReverse: {name} will listen on {listen} on its loopback address and bring every connection to port {local} on this computer. Every user and program on the host can reach that port of this computer through it. Continue only if you trust the host.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleInvalidListen: Enter a host port from 1 to 65535, or leave it empty.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.rulePortInUse: Port {port} is used by another program on the host. Choose another port or leave it empty.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.rulePortDenied: The host does not allow listening on port {port}. Ports below 1024 usually need administrator rights.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleUnsupported: The remote server running on the host cannot listen on host ports. Reconnect to update it.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.rulesHelp: Forwarding rules listen on a host port and forward to another server or back to this computer. They stop when the connection ends; the window remembers them, and after reconnecting you start them again with Start.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.ruleAllInterfacesTi: Listens on every interface of the host: any computer that can reach the host can connect to this port.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.labelBody: The label is shown in the Label column and kept on this computer for this workspace. Leave it empty to remove it.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.labelInvalid: Use at most 64 characters, without line breaks or tabs.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.recordsFailed: The ports and rules of this workspace could not be remembered: {reason}
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.recordsDamaged: The saved ports and rules of remote workspaces cannot be read, so they are not restored and changes are not saved. The file in the Lithe settings folder is left as it is.
en-US.desktop.remote.ports.restoreFailed: Forwards not restored after reconnecting: {count}. See the affected rows for details.

zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.title: 端口
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.help: 转发的端口只监听本机的回环地址（127.0.0.1）。本机上的所有程序都能连接，不只是 Lithe；主机无法通过它反向访问本机。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.localChanged: 本机端口 {requested} 已被占用，改用 {port}。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.addInvalid: 请输入 1–65535 的端口、“主机:端口”，或 http://localhost:3000 这样的网址。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.addCredentials: 地址不能包含用户名或密码。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.empty: 主机上没有正在监听的端口。也可以在上方输入端口直接转发。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.loading: 正在读取主机上的监听端口…
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.disconnected: 未连接。转发随连接一起结束；重新连接后，没有停止的本地转发会自动恢复。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.readFailed: 无法读取主机上的监听端口：{reason}
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.limit: 此连接已转发 {maximum} 个端口，达到上限，请先停止一个。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.confirmBody: {target} 不是 {name} 自身的回环地址。转发后，本机上的所有程序都能经由主机访问这个地址。请确认你信任它后再继续。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.statusTooltip: 已转发 {count} 个端口，点击打开“端口”窗口。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.localBody: 把 {name} 上的 {remote} 转发到本机回环地址的这个端口。如果它已被其他程序占用，会改用一个空闲端口，并在这一行注明。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.localInvalid: 请输入 1 到 65535 之间的端口号。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleKindHost: 主机端口 → 另一台服务器
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleKindReverse: 主机端口 → 本机（反向转发）
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleReverseOff: 把主机端口转发回本机（反向转发）默认关闭，可在 设置 › 工具 › 远程工作区 中允许。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleHostNote: {name} 监听下面的端口，并由主机自己连接目标，数据不经过本机。默认只监听主机的回环地址（127.0.0.1），只有主机上的程序能连接。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleReverseNote: {name} 在回环地址（127.0.0.1）上监听下面的端口，把每个连接转回本机回环地址上的端口。主机上的所有用户都能连接这个端口。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleTargetPlacehold: 端口、主机:端口或网址，由主机连接
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleLocalPlaceholde: 本机回环地址上的端口，如 3000
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleAllInterfacesNo: 能访问这台主机的任何电脑都能连接这个端口，并经由它访问目标。每次添加都会再次确认，不会记住。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleConfirmAll: {name} 将在全部网卡上监听{listen}，并把连接转到 {target}。能访问这台主机的任何电脑都能连接它，不只是你。请确认主机所在的网络可信后再继续。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleListenAny: 一个由主机选择的端口
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleConfirmTarget: {target} 不是 {name} 自身的回环地址。添加后，能连接这个主机端口的程序都能经由主机访问这个地址。请确认你信任它后再继续。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleConfirmReverseT: 把主机端口转发回本机？
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleConfirmReverse: {name} 将在回环地址上监听{listen}，并把每个连接转到本机的端口 {local}。主机上的所有用户和程序都能借此连接本机的这个端口。请确认你信任这台主机后再继续。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleInvalidListen: 主机端口请输入 1 到 65535 之间的端口号，或留空。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.rulePortInUse: 主机上的端口 {port} 已被其他程序占用，请换一个端口或留空。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.rulePortDenied: 主机不允许监听端口 {port}。普通用户通常不能使用 1024 以下的端口。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleUnsupported: 这台主机上运行的远端服务不支持在主机上监听端口，请重新连接以更新远端服务。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.rulesHelp: 转发规则在主机上监听端口，转到另一台服务器或转回本机。规则随连接结束而停止；窗口会记住它们，重新连接后点“启动”即可再次启动。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.ruleAllInterfacesTi: 监听主机的全部网卡：能访问主机的任何电脑都能连接这个端口。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.labelBody: 标签显示在“标签”列，只保存在这台电脑上、只用于这个工作区。留空即删除标签。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.labelInvalid: 最多 64 个字符，不能包含换行或制表符。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.recordsFailed: 无法保存这个工作区的端口和规则：{reason}
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.recordsDamaged: 已保存的远程工作区端口和规则无法读取，因此不会恢复，改动也不会保存。Lithe 设置目录中的文件保持原样。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.ports.restoreFailed: 重新连接后有 {count} 个转发无法恢复，原因见对应行。
